text: The Gram Nyayalayas Act, 2008 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20094 Act Number: 4 Enactment Date: 2009-01-07 Act Year: 2009 Short Title: The Gram Nyayalayas Act, 2008 Long Title: An Act to provide for the establishment of Gram Nyayalayas at the grass roots level for the purposes of providing access to justice to the citizens at their doorsteps and to ensure that opportunities for securing justice are not denied to any citizen by reason of social, economic or other disabilities and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
